name: Items 2: the crafted accessories at tier 7 numbers (what jewelry and cloaks to tier 7 are worth from Level 110 on)
why: 54-review-items call 1. The kit wears a tier 3 ring, tier 2 studs, a tier 2 necklace and a tier 3 cloak at every Level from 30 up, because nothing later has a source. This patch gives those four rows the numbers of a tier 7 step on their own ladder (a point a tier for every style: rings 3 to 7, studs and necklace 2 to 7; the cloak takes the unsourced Dawnlit Mantle's 255 steady and 3 damage for every style). Read it at Level 110 and past only: at Level 30 and 60 the same rows are worn, so those cells are not the proposal. It targets the gear bands.. D-3 ruling 6 (08-designer-d3.md): a cell plays these numbers only from Level 110, times 0.5 to Level 185 and 1.0 from 186 (plan.jewelryStandIn, matrix-plan.mjs); under 110 the rows play as the tree holds them The four rows carry no stat fields since the named-pieces pass (28-named-pieces.md: every piece's numbers are the gear formula's), so the patch has no row edits: the numbers ride plan.jewelryStandIn alone, which set these same fields at every Level before (lane/ci-reds-client-1123)
